timing: Before any claim decisions, after primary baseline response review; secondary descriptive analysis only
unit: Distinct explicitly asserted contextual propositions per response. Split independently checkable conjunctions. Do not count repeated conclusions twice. A fee equation is assessed as a fee claim, not rescued by context-free arithmetic. Source attribution is attached to its proposition, not counted again as a second claim.
limits: Single AI segmentation and labels; dependent claims and output length affect rates; no population-level hallucination claim
